specific_objectives: 15.1.7.2 Trainee will be able to explain float type fuel quantity measurement indicator.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of float type gauge mechanism using model; Safety: Handle float arm gently to avoid damage; Supervision: Instructor monitors trainee interaction with model components
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a fuel quantity indicator?
Name two types of fuel gauges used in aircraft.
How does the float type gauge differ from the capacitance type gauge?

topics: Constructional details of float type gauge
development.content:
Constructional details of float type gauge
Float arm and lever mechanism
Magnetic reed switch operation
Fuel tank installation requirements
Electrical circuit connections

Principle of operation explanation
Float movement and switch actuation
Signal transmission to cockpit indicator
Calibration and zeroing procedures
Common failure modes and causes

Practical demonstration of gauge operation
Verification of switch actuation points
Troubleshooting simulated faults
Documentation of observations
Safety checks during practical session

summary_questions: Explain how the float movement translates into an electrical signal.
Describe the role of the magnetic reed switch in the gauge operation.
List three potential causes for inaccurate fuel readings in a float type gauge.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the float type gauge with the capacitance type gauge, focusing on their operating principles and applications, to be discussed in Lesson Plan 18.
